messages:
anna_marketing: Quick sync — launching blog + webinar next Tues. Need a crisp SEO implementation plan: URL siloing, canonicalization rules, redirects for legacy pages, and JSON-LD for product/benchmarks. Who can own the URL map and redirect list?

mike_seo: I can take URL map + canonical rules. Will draft a recommended hierarchy and preferred slugs. Quick Q: do we keep /blog/ vs /docs/ for benchmark posts?

jess_ops: I think benchmarks should live under /benchmarks/ (better for nav + internal linking). Blog can cross-link.

anna_marketing: @mike_seo +1 to /benchmarks/. Marketing wants short slugs, no dates. Avoid /YYYY/MM/ style.

mike_seo: Got it. Draft plan outline:
- preferred hostname: redwood.ai (canonical)
- benchmarks under: /benchmarks/<model>-vs-<baseline>/slug-friendly
- launch post under: /blog/launch-<product>/
- canonical meta to point to chosen slug if duplicates exist

michelle_dev: For redirects, we'll add 301 rules in nginx and a fallback rewrite in our CDN (Fastly). Example rules I plan to push:```
# preserve query strings, canonicalize trailing slash
rewrite ^/old-benchmark/(.*)$ /benchmarks/$1 permanent;
rewrite ^/blog/(\d{4})/(\d{2})/(.*)$ /blog/$3 permanent;
```

tom_growth: Can we add a redirect map spreadsheet with 3 columns: old path, new path, reason? I'll own filling gaps with PMs.

mike_seo: Yes. I'll share initial CSV tonight. Also adding a small canonical policy: prefer non-trailing-slash canonical for content pages, but allow trailing slash on category pages.

jess_ops: Internal linking checklist for launch:
- link from homepage feature block to benchmark page
- add contextual links from docs -> benchmarks (methodology)
- add cross-links inside benchmark post to related blog and product pages
- ensure nav includes Benchmarks top-level item

seo-bot: Reminder: submit sitemap update after redirects go live and mark moved URLs as 'moved' in Search Console.

anna_marketing: Mike — include schema suggestions for benchmarks (JSON-LD: Article + Dataset + SoftwareApplication hints). Can you paste an example snippet?

mike_seo: Example JSON-LD to include in benchmark pages (trimmed):```
<script type=\"application/ld+json\">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Article",
  "headline": "Benchmark: redwood-13B vs baseline",
  "author": {"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},
  "mainEntity": {"@type":"Dataset","name":"benchmark-results-2026"},
  "publisher": {"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}
}
</script>
```

michelle_dev: Tech note: we'll also add canonical HTTP header for static exports so crawlers see it immediately. I'll coordinate with platform to set the header when we deploy the redirect manifest.

tom_growth: Webinar landing page routing? Keep it under /events/webinar-launch-2026 and canonicalize to that. We'll add UTM templates in links.

mike_seo: One more: add breadcrumb schema for benchmark pages to improve SERP context.

anna_marketing: Awesome. Next steps: Mike to share CSV + slug list by EOD. Michelle to draft nginx redirect PR. Tom to create webinar landing path and share UTM spec. Jess to update nav ticket. I'll compile a final checklist for launch assets. :thumbsup:

mike_seo: Pulling CSV together now, ping me in #marketing if you want early access.

jess_ops: I'll add nav + internal link tasks to the sprint board.

michelle_dev: Will start the redirect manifest branch — tagging @platform for review.

tom_growth: I'll draft webinar page copy and send to design. ETA tomorrow.

anna_marketing: Perfect. Closing this thread — we'll reconvene after PRs open. Thanks all! :rocket:
